author. I authored the earlier `next-unit.md`, not this candidate or its ten

## Smallest substantive unit

Root's phased `Formals` proposal is viable without a fresh whole-body Index
for this bounded factor. State must advance every original static ordinal,
own preceding Nat/Basis key sets, retain each checked ordinary Op `Type<N>`
and existing finite Meaning payload, and derive one access mask in original
requirement order. Both actual consumers must move those checked facts into
finite `Bindings` and sized `Scope.operations`; sized adds its existing single
Q wrapper once. Keeping both old insertion/duplicate-access judgments, or
running only a shared access preflight before rebuilding types, is insufficient.

This is shared ordered formal policy over original declaration ordinals and
the existing indexed type projection. It is not yet a common complete body
checker or a direct-original-Natural-occurrence judgment. The frozen candidate
currently leaves the lexical bridge open; record the selected existing-projection
route explicitly before code instead of silently claiming the stronger route.

`Projection::natural` already retains actual `Reference.local`/`UseSiteId`
from `Index::natural_usage`; `TypeParameter.key` similarly comes from the
original indexed Named occurrence. `ParsedProgram` owns private immutable
source/projection data; checking selects the original through actual
DefId → canonical module → ast_index. No name/span reconstruction is needed.
Use that exact original Decl, complete static count, every original kind/ordinal
paired with the projected kind/key, and complete requirement count/ordinal when
access uses both forms. Require indexed keys, never discarded preflight `None`.
The actual local Table target/category must be authoritative; do not consult
`UseInfo.global` or `static_parameter` as fallback candidates.

Finite obtains keys from its current borrowed `Forest.binder/info/key`. Sized
obtains them from each indexed `BindingName.key` and retained lexical Table,
with structural ID/category consistency assertions. Access checks use finite
`Forest.local_key` or sized actual local Reference plus Table category, and the
shared state must contain that same StaticOperation key. Binder identity is not
the string name, span, axis label, provider annotation or static argument number.

## Phase and consumer invariants

- Finite keeps profile and dependency checks, signature static/runtime names
  and runtime/result types, then per-Op basis, finite contract-width check,
  Meaning lookup/tree comparison/matrix charge, then ordered access. Retain
  each checked basis/refinement result immediately; do not delay Meaning work
  past the next parameter. Unsupported Nat/Basis/predicate paths stay blocked.
- Sized keeps complete projection and indexed Named-category rejection first,
  static uniqueness/all-Nat premise context/feasibility next, then ordered
  kinds/access, then runtime names/types/binding and result/body/effect checks.
  The premise context's later Nat is distinct from an earlier kind's available
  Nat set. Every profile callback must use the common preceding sets.
- Preserve sized `ty`'s two phases: full Parameter availability and substitution
  capacity/depth scan first; only afterward `map_parts` normalizes Naturals.
  `basis-scan-priority` therefore tests later Basis availability before earlier
  `n*n`. Within a Natural, `natural_inner` retains left-to-right evaluation;
  `natural-priority` tests `n*n` before later k availability. One mixed prewalk
  or eager all-name collection changes the current contract.
- Move the checked ordinary basis into actual Op storage, preserving tuple
  tags/order, Unit/Bits0/Bit/Bits1, opaque Basis identity, quantum-owner shape,
  4096-node/depth64 and existing linear/finite charges. The shared mask maps
  Apply/Adjoint/Controlled once; do not derive capabilities from unitarity.
  Preserve finite constraint-name span versus sized whole-constraint span.
- Keep all declaration/body loops. Valid `main` never suppresses private or
  unused generic checks, either static branch or zero-fold body checks. This
  factor does not establish every concrete specialization or source preservation.

## Lifetime and cost arrangement

The no-reindex route owns/clones only declaration-local BinderKeys and checked
type/refinement facts. Its original Decl and projected Function references
are ordinary temporary borrows. The common state returns owned facts; no
source-address map or borrowed Index is stored in `ParsedProgram`, and no
self-referential collection or public-Project cache is introduced. Existing
finite `Compiler<'ast>` still holds its immovable source borrow for the entire
Forest lifetime; create the shared state per actual check, not across calls.
Do not clone complete Scope values/context for each kind merely to select the
available maps; a callback can borrow the common sets and existing context.
Finite callback borrows may require cloning the actual local key before a
mutable Compiler type/refinement call. This is host allocation analysis only,
not a measured resource guarantee or permission to change work accounting.

If a later unit requires direct original Natural-address lookup, there are two
concrete arrangements: retain `natural_references` when the already-built
Index is consumed by finite Forest (one map retention and same `'ast` borrow,
no extra walk), and create a declaration-local sized `Index<'decl>` only while
checking an immutable original Decl. For the latter use actual DefId/module/
ast_index and the existing module import resolver; compare structural binder
and use identities with the indexed projection, return owned facts and drop
the Index before leaving that check. It adds one full iterative declaration
walk and O(binders+uses) retained metadata for that declaration, with BTreeMap
operations, even for unused bodies; it needs explicit bounded-work review.
Neither arrangement is necessary merely to use today's projected exact keys.
